<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 211.076 corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, giving a neutral mass of ~210.069 Da. The strong M+2 peak (~33 % of the base) indicates a single chlorine atom (Cl‑35/Cl‑37 isotopic pattern). Fitting the exact mass with one Cl, one O, and appropriate C/H counts yields the formula C₁₂H₁₅OCl, which matches the observed mass within typical high‑resolution tolerance and explains the isotopic pattern.</thought>
<final_answer>C12H15OCl</final_answer>
